## Crash Report

### Exception
**Type:** `System.IO.FileNotFoundException`
**Message:** Could not load file or assembly 'ObjectListView, Version=2.9.3.0, Culture=neutral, PublicKeyToken=null'. The system cannot find the file specified.

### Stack Trace
```
   at void mRemoteNG.UI.Window.ConnectionTreeWindow.InitializeComponent() in D:/a/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/mRemoteNG/UI/Window/ConnectionTreeWindow.Designer.cs:line 20
   at new mRemoteNG.UI.Window.ConnectionTreeWindow(DockContent panel) i...

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
This came in as an automatic crash report, so there may be nobody reading — but the diagnosis is worth recording, and something has been changed because of it.

`ObjectListView` is built and shipped next to `mRemoteNG.exe` on every build, so it cannot be absent unless the installation itself is incomplete: a half-extracted download, a file antivirus has quarantined, or two different mRemoteNG downloads mixed into one folder. **If you hit this, re-extract the download over the folder or reinstall...

notes: fix shipped; awaiting reporter confirm on nightly
